title: Context Recall Cards
user: Independent language learners who know a word in an app but cannot retrieve it in a real sentence; they need short, personally meaningful recall practice with pronunciation.

evidence.quote_or_summary: Learners use streaks and flashcards for months yet still forget vocabulary when they need it.
A spaced-repetition learner asks for per-side recording and playback to practice pronunciation from personal cards.

smallest_useful_product: An offline-first PWA for a learner-written sentence and optional recording, scheduled through listen, cloze, and speak-back prompts with the original context.
success_measure: In four weeks, 50% of learners add 30 or more contexts and complete delayed spoken recall for at least 70% of them.
constraints: Recordings stay on device by default; consent before sharing; browser media APIs only; no AI, copyrighted courses, or speech-scoring claims.
